proposals.evidence: The whole response is intransitive burn + gone. Turner *dvalati supplies the regional bal-/baḷ-/bar- burn family; gata supplies the suppletive gay-/gy-/go- auxiliary. The elicited intransitive sense determines this family rather than transitive *dvālayati; source vowel length and finite endings are preserved. Both ordered constituents are linked.

Both lexical constituents are included even where the source writes them together; no separate copula is present in these selected forms.
